Here is the recap of Havlumi's 7-day Valentine's Day X campaign (**Monday, February 8, 2027 – Sunday, February 14, 2027**, Singapore Time / `Asia/Singapore`).

---

### 1. Executive Summary & Overall Results

| Metric | Result | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Spend** | **$545.93 USD** | 99.26% utilization of the $550.00 USD total budget (`545,930,331` micros) |
| **Impressions** | **1,407,702** | 1,367,479 unique iOS users reached worldwide (ex-China); 1.03 avg. frequency |
| **Link Clicks** | **1,288** | Taps through to `https://havlumi.app/valentine` (`0.0915%` link CTR, **$0.424** avg. CPC) |
| **Total Engagements** | **10,345** | Includes 1,288 link clicks, 226 likes, 7 reposts, 5 replies |
| **Completed App Installs** | *Tracked in Havlumi app reporting* | Because `havlumi.app` does not use an X pixel or linked App ID, X reports **link clicks** to your landing page rather than completed App Store installs |

---

### 2. Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)

Every ad group enforced strict **iOS-only (`PLATFORM = iOS`)** and **Worldwide excluding China (`LOCATION != China`)** targeting with audience expansion disabled (`DEFINED`) so that 100% of delivery reached eligible iPhone users.

| Line Item | Active Window (SGT) | Promoted Post(s) | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Link CTR | Cost / Link Click |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **LI1 – Relationships & Couples Intent** (`mfd2i`) | Feb 8 (Day 1 test) | All 3 posts | $23.96 | 34,907 | 37 | 0.1060% | $0.647 |
| **LI2 – Photography & Visual Storytelling** (`zvw8q`) | Feb 8 (Day 1 test) | All 3 posts | $21.86 | 44,788 | 34 | 0.0759% | $0.643 |
| **LI4 – Broad iOS Pre-Qualified** (`90gs5`) | Feb 8 (Day 1 test) | Posts 1 & 3 | $15.75 | 65,879 | 44 | 0.0668% | $0.358 |
| **LI3 – Valentine Keepsake Offer Focus** (`9eop7`) | Feb 8 – Feb 11 | Post 2 only | $35.35 | 116,729 | 61 | 0.0523% | $0.580 |
| **LI5 – Relationships & Couples \| Post 3 Winner** (`g9z66`) | Feb 9 – Feb 14 | Post 3 only | $152.96 | 270,471 | 310 | **0.1146%** | $0.493 |
| **LI6 – Broad iOS \| Post 3 Winner** (`i4gik`) | Feb 9 – Feb 14 | Post 3 only | $195.71 | 642,394 | 579 | 0.0901% | **$0.338** |
| **LI7 – Photography & Lookalikes \| Post 3 Winner** (`decxd`) | Feb 9 – Feb 14 | Post 3 only | $100.34 | 232,534 | 223 | 0.0959% | $0.450 |
| **Total (Campaign `3sihp`)** | **Feb 8 – Feb 14** | **3 Approved Posts** | **$545.93** | **1,407,702** | **1,288** | **0.0915%** | **$0.424** |

---

### 3. Performance by Approved Post (Creative Breakdown)

| Post ID | Copy Summary | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Link CTR | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **`2150625287996295112`** (Post 3) | *"Choose three photos, add dates and captions, then save one collage image. Havlumi is free to download with six everyday layouts included. iPhone (iOS) only; available worldwide except China..."* | **$483.99** | **1,211,939** | **1,179** | **0.0973%** | **$0.411** |
| **`2150444094061922123`** (Post 2) | *"Give someone a little history of you two. Make a photo collage with Havlumi on iPhone and add the eight-layout Valentine Keepsake Pack free by February 14, 2027, to keep afterward..."* | **$48.60** | **142,341** | **82** | **0.0576%** | **$0.593** |
| **`2150262900128148936`** (Post 1) | *"Three photos, one little story. Havlumi turns your pictures into a collage strip with dates and captions. Download free on iPhone and keep six everyday layouts..."* | **$13.31** | **53,422** | **27** | **0.0505%** | **$0.493** |

---

### 4. Key Observations & What Worked

1. **Practical "How-It-Works" + Explicit Pre-Qualification (`2150625287996295112`) Outperformed on Both Click Rate and Install Intent:**
   - On Day 1, when all three posts ran head-to-head inside the same ad groups, Post `2150625287996295112` achieved more than **2x the link CTR** of Post `2150262900128148936` (`0.163%` vs. `0.059%` in Relationships & Couples; `0.107%` vs. `0.045%` in Photography; `0.080%` vs. `0.047%` in Broad iOS) and also beat the Valentine Keepsake Pack post (`2150444094061922123`).
   - Because Post `2150625287996295112` leads with concrete steps (*"Choose three photos, add dates and captions, then save one collage image"*) and states key eligibility terms up front (*"free to download with six everyday layouts included. iPhone (iOS) only; available worldwide except China"*), users who clicked through to `https://havlumi.app/valentine` were already pre-qualified on price, device, and functionality—maximizing downstream conversion from link clicks to completed iPhone installs.
2. **Isolating the Winning Post Cut Cost per Link Click by 38%:**
   - Pausing the mixed-creative test ad groups after Day 1 and isolating Post `2150625287996295112` in `LI5`, `LI6`, and `LI7` reduced overall campaign cost per link click from **$0.548 on Day 1** down to **$0.338–$0.493** over the rest of the flight, lifting daily link clicks from **136 on Day 1** to **200+ per day** during the peak pre-Valentine window.
3. **Audience Trade-Offs (High-Intent Relationships vs. Broad iOS):**
   - **Relationships, Dating, Marriage & Family + Valentine Keywords (`LI5`)** generated the highest engagement intent (**0.1146% link CTR**), reaching users actively thinking about a partner or family keepsake ahead of February 14.
   - **Broad iOS ex-China (`LI6`)** paired with the self-qualifying copy of Post `2150625287996295112` delivered the lowest cost per link click (**$0.338 CPC**, 579 link clicks) while maintaining a strong **0.0901% link CTR**.
   - **Photography, Design & `@Havlumi` Follower Lookalikes (`LI7`)** provided a balanced middle ground (**0.0959% link CTR** at **$0.450 CPC**, 223 link clicks).
